$comment: Ordinal font-size ramp. A step name is its POSITION on the ramp, not the value sitting there - so retuning a step never makes its name a lie. `hero` is a fluid clamp() rather than a step on the ramp, so it keeps a name.

400.comment: utility step — off the 4px grid (like 14), for body-large / small subheads

600.comment: utility step — off the 4px grid, sits between h5 (20) and h4 (24)

hero.comment: container-query driven headline, above the fixed ramp
